summary: The team is juggling multiple high-priority initiatives—finalizing the Going Global report and its launch at the Tech in Asia luncheon, reworking the knowledge website and newsletter, and driving SEO for Asia Star and Intelligent China—while clearing urgent IT issues and preparing for upcoming deadlines.
summaryDetail: The most pressing focus this week is the CKGSB luncheon at Tech in Asia and the associated 'Chinese Companies' New Playbook for Going Global' report: Ira is incorporating feedback on the report, finalizing the Global Marcom work report for Zongchao, and coordinating with Xuan and Melvin on speaker invitations and Dean Xiang's 15-minute slot, with Julie sending flyer feedback to Flow. In parallel, the website redesign is moving forward—Joseph needs to share his HTML design and gather feedback from Julie and the lead, while the team has decided to keep the current site as a base, integrate videos into topic sections, and remove the separate video category. SEO efforts are ramping up for Asia Star and Intelligent China, with Joseph drafting target areas and prompts, the team analyzing participant and CRM data for audience profiles, and the SEO manager briefing on conversion tracking. Additionally, the CKGSB brand video and monthly newsletter template are awaiting Joseph's revisions based on feedback, and the EV seminar summary needs to be sent to Zongchao. Urgently, the Outlook login issue is disrupting team access—everyone must delete and re-add accounts on all devices to restore functionality. Upcoming deadlines include the SEM contract for Ben's Indonesian program, speaker confirmations for the luncheon, and finalizing the report launch logistics.
